specs.title: Hamburger menu opens, traps focus, closes on Escape and on route change
Dialogs and task panel fit within viewport and are fully scrollable
Landing page anchor jump leaves headings visible
Orientation change (portrait to landscape) maintains zero overflow
Ultra-compact viewports (320x568 and 640x360 zoom equivalent) fit cleanly
Very long names (120+ chars) and emails do not cause horizontal page overflow
Board with 60 tasks renders and scrolls with zero page overflow
Board and dashboard with zero tasks render empty states cleanly without overflow
Slow network with delayed API preserves layout and cold-start notice fits on screen
